versions.label: Checkpoint persistence + clearer RL comparisons
changes: Added RL-specific local checkpoint persistence for settings, learning progress, and the learned Q-table.
Expanded the learning chart and stats panel to show stored checkpoint status, value estimates, and visited-state progress.
Archived the previous current build as pong_RL/versions/1.0.1/pong_RL.html.

versions.label: Initial standalone RL comparison app
changes: Added a standalone Pong RL app that mirrors the Pong Evolution layout for side-by-side comparison.
Replaced neuroevolution with tabular Q-learning over discretized Pong state and action values.
Added RL-native charts, controls, logs, and independent version-history wiring under pong_RL/.

versions.label: Archived baseline RL build
changes: First archived Pong RL build with episode rewards, epsilon-greedy exploration, and Q-table learning.
Stored as a separate app tree so RL iteration remains independent from the evolution app.
